# Execution Plan Template

## Title
One-line change title.

## Status
- Status: planned
- Owner: TBD
- Branch: TBD
- PR: TBD
- Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD

Allowed statuses: planned, in progress, blocked, needs human validation, ready for review, completed, abandoned.

## Summary
- What is changing
- Why it is changing
- What is explicitly out of scope

## Work State
- Planned:
- In progress:
- Blocked:
- Needs human validation:
- Ready for review:
- Completed:

## Decisions
- Key design decision
- Default assumptions
- Open risks or dependency notes

## Implementation
- Files or areas to update
- Behavior to add, remove, or preserve
- Any public or operational contract that must remain stable

## Validation
- Checks to run
- Validation evidence and results
- What cannot be validated locally
- Date checked

## Human Validation
- Owner
- Exact steps
- Expected evidence
- Evidence location
- Whether this blocks merge

## Documentation
- Docs to update in the same change
- Where completed plan should move after implementation

## Closeout
- Final status
- Merge or abandonment notes
- Follow-up work items
